shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular panel
band of dense inscribed script combined with figural imagery
human or humanoid figures in strict profile
registers or horizontal divisions separating text from figures
small handheld object carried by a figure
justification: Both surfaces combine a block of dense writing with profile figural relief divided into horizontal registers, and both include winged motifs and figures with raised arms holding small objects. But A shows a single large bird-headed winged being with a bucket beside a stylised flowering plant filling the whole field, while B shows a solar winged disc over multiple registers of small seated and standing worshippers with offering tables; proportions, scale of figures and the specific subjects are quite different.
